integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and explicitly handles \(p=1\) separately.
The subcritical obstruction has upper gradient zero and finite weighted norm; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the fixed disconnected geometric interval family and power weights \(x^{-\alpha}\).
It does not classify arbitrary weights, connected metric spaces, outer-capacity properties, or all weakly quasicontinuous functions.
title: The critical weight for continuous representatives on accumulating intervals
